jobs.title: Senior Director AI - Chief Revenue Organization
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where tech thinkers and future builders turn bold ideas into breakthrough experiences, we welcome your unique perspective.

Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Director of AI Solutions to lead the design, engineering, and deployment of generative AI and machine learning systems across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for building and scaling production-grade AI systems that directly drive revenue outcomes, including pipeline growth, deal acceleration, customer retention, and operational efficiency.

You will operate at the intersection of AI engineering, enterprise architecture, and go-to-market strategy, partnering closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering leaders to translate AI capabilities into measurable business value.

Responsibilities

Lead End-to-End GenAI and ML System Delivery

Design and deploy generative AI and machine learning solutions embedded in CRM and customer workflows. Build systems including LLM-powered copilots, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, and predictive models. Own the full lifecycle from data sourcing and model development to evaluation, deployment, and monitoring

Drive Hands-On ML Engineering Excellence

Architect and guide implementation of model training and fine-tuning pipelines using frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Hugging Face. Build real-time and batch inference systems, embedding pipelines, and vector database integrations. Establish best practices for CI/CD, experimentation, model evaluation, and observability across AI systems

Scale Agentic AI Systems

Design and deploy agent-based systems capable of multi-step reasoning, tool usage, and workflow orchestration across enterprise platforms. Establish reusable patterns for prompt management, tool integration, policy enforcement, and agent lifecycle management.
Drive Revenue Impact Through AI
Partner with Sales and go-to-market leadership to embed AI into deal strategy and customer engagements. Contribute directly to pipeline growth, deal velocity, and account expansion. Translate AI capabilities into measurable outcomes including conversion improvement, productivity gains, and customer retention.
Lead Cross-Functional Execution
Collaborate across Engineering, Data, Product, Sales, and Customer Success to deliver integrated AI solutions. Translate complex business problems into scalable technical architectures and ensure alignment across systems, data, and workflows.
Build and Lead High-Performing Teams
Lead and grow teams of ML engineers, ML scientists, and AI architects. Establish a high bar for engineering quality, execution, and technical depth. Build scalable development practices and delivery models for enterprise AI.

Qualifications

Experience

12–15+ years of experience in AI/ML, data science, or distributed systems engineering. 8+ years leading ML or AI engineering teams in platform or infrastructure environments. Proven track record delivering production-grade AI systems at enterprise scale. Experience partnering with Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success organizations to drive business outcomes

Technical Expertise

Deep hands-on experience with generative AI including LLMs, prompt engineering, and fine-tuning. Strong experience with retrieval-augmented generation architectures and agentic AI systems. Proficiency with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. Experience with cloud platforms including AWS, GCP, or Azure, and modern data stacks. Strong understanding of distributed systems, CI/CD, experimentation frameworks, and observability

Leadership and Business Acumen

Ability to operate as both a technical leader and business partner. Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills. Experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across highly matrixed organizations. Ability to translate complex technical systems into clear business value
Experience with building AI solutions for Enterprise and driving value through revenue growth like New Logo’s, Recommendations for Crosssell-Upselll
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Salesforce or enterprise CRM ecosystems. Experience building internal AI platforms or developer tooling. Background in SaaS or enterprise software environments. Advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field

At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As part of HDR’s Building Engineering Services Group, you’ll help design the critical infrastructure that supports the digital age and shapes the spaces where people work, connect, and thrive. From high-performance data centers driving the future of AI to dynamic commercial environments, your work will directly support technological advancement, sustainability, and human experience. Partner with key stakeholders to identify and develop a network of Technical Experts/Subject Matter Experts as needed to support the HDR enterprise.
Work to identify programmatic hardware and software needs, such as high-powered computing and modeling, and work with corporate information technology to facilitate and implement solutions.
Develop strategies and support practice and professional discipline groups to foster technology talent collaboration and skills development.

Leverages extensive experience in leading planning professionals and utilizes deep technical planning expertise to motivate and challenge a team of advanced planning professionals with expertise in tax, estate and trust, business advisory & succession planning and philanthropy. Provides advanced planning services to HNW and UHNW clients and supports all frontline professionals who are delivering planning within Personal Wealth ensuring they have access to ongoing resources, tools and systems to assist in complex planning issues. Develops a strategy to ensure BMO has leading and competitive capabilities in specialized planning to meet the complex and comprehensive needs of HNW and UHNW clients. Leads a centre of expertise, building and executing BMO’s strategy to be a thought leader internally and externally around wealth planning across North America. Develops and leads the distribution and sales support strategy to ensure specialized planning knowledge is leveraged by the other professionals within the function and frontline professionals. Develops and drives the strategic plan for the delivery of best in class specialized wealth planning services and sets the groundwork to ensure the needs of HNW and UHNW clients are optimally met by partnering with lead relationship managers in WM and other LoBs, and where appropriate other external professionals and Centres of Influence. Collaborate across BMO to identify cross LOB business opportunities leveraging specialized planning team.

Become the growth engine of Private Wealth Canada by identifying significant wealth management opportunities such as investment, insurance, trust, lending and other revenue sources through holistic sophisticated wealth planning delivery engagements.
Provides overall leadership and strategic direction to the Specialized Wealth Planning Team by setting context and direction, defining accountabilities, tasks and assignments and establishing boundaries for decision-making and approvals.
Coaches, motivates, develops and evaluates performance of specialized planning leaders and provides guidance and mentoring to those direct reports in the resolution of complex issues
Establishes and maintains a sales management process to ensure opportunities for portfolio growth and profile enhancement are maximized including: maximizing the expertise of internal partners; establishing and strengthening relationships with other sales forces; recognizing referral opportunities to BMO Financial Group partners
Partners with key groups such as NA Commercial Banking to identify cross business referral opportunities through leveraging specialized resources. Partners with colleagues in the U.S. , if required, to ensure cross border planning expertise is being leveraged to meet clients’ North American planning needs.
Ensures consistent communication of strategy and messaging between Enterprise Wealth Planning and the LOBs
Hold employees accountable to their business/sales plans; conducts thorough performance assessments; coaches and provides candid feedback; ensures alignment of rewards to objectives, alignment with team and to BMO Financial Group values
Instills collaborative approach to ensure team members partner with colleagues in Enterprise Wealth Planning and across BMO Financial Group in providing financial solutions to clients
Partners with Wealth Planning Leaders and Market Leaders to recruit, develop and promote a high performing planning team in order to provide the leadership and bench strength necessary over the long-term to meet Wealth Managements strategic business and growth objectives
Partners with market leadership to ensure each market has access to the specific specialized planning support required
Develops talent strategy and ongoing pipeline for specialized planning professionals for Personal Wealth
Leads the development and guides the implementation of the strategy to provide advanced and specialized planning advice and services within Wealth Management
Partners with the Wealth Management leadership to develop the engagement and delivery model of overall planning support for high value clients
Assesses and approves external experts qualified to provide advisors with tax and estate planning services
Provides front line sales force with accurate and detailed subject matter expertise in all areas of wealth management
Serves as in-house expert in providing financial planning support on technical issues in the areas of investment planning, education planning, retirement planning and transition planning, with general knowledge of estate planning, personal taxation and insurance.
Promotes the services of the HNW Consulting & Financial Planning strategy of technical experts across Personal Wealth
Ensures team is knowledgeable on wealth products and services (including advice content, process and tools) and have a general understanding of the products and services across BMO Financial Group and its partners
Provides SME and thought leadership regarding selection/development of tools and technology platforms to be utilized by wealth planning professionals
Contributes to the building of the Enterprise Centre of Expertise for Wealth Planning (processes, workflow, delivery strategy), specifically in terms of the HNW and UHNW client segments for BMO Personal Wealth

Provides oversight and handles all escalations from team on complex deals, provide insight and direction to team members, experts and IAs on best course of action

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO) Strategic Business Executive
jobs.description:
Come... Enjoy... Work
in a fast paced, dynamic environment. Located on the Tsuut’ina First Nation, Grey Eagle Resort & Casino is Calgary’s number one entertainment facility. We are looking for talented, energetic and motivated individuals to join our diverse workforce! We offer competitive salaries, benefits and opportunities to grow your career.

Position Overview

The Chief Financial Officer (CFO) is a key executive leader responsible for the financial stewardship, strategic planning, governance support, and long-term sustainability of Grey Eagle Resort & Casino (GERC).

Reporting directly to the Board of Directors, the CFO serves as the principal financial advisor to the Board and Executive Leadership Team, providing leadership across financial operations, capital investment planning, enterprise risk management, business growth initiatives, and stakeholder relations.

The CFO plays a critical role in supporting the Board's vision for sustainable economic growth while protecting and enhancing the assets of Grey Eagle Resort & Casino for future generations of the Tsuut'ina Nation.

The role oversees all financial functions and provides executive leadership for major capital projects, resort renovations, business development initiatives, financing strategies, and governance matters affecting the organization.

As one of the most senior leaders within GERC, the CFO must balance strategic thinking, operational understanding, financial discipline, and relationship-building with a diverse group of stakeholders including the Board of Directors, Tsuut'ina Nation leadership, regulators, financial institutions, development partners, and operational leaders.

Education And Experience

CPA designation.
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or related discipline.
Minimum 10 years progressive financial leadership experience.
Minimum 5 years in a senior executive role.
Experience in hospitality, gaming, resort, entertainment, tourism, real estate development, or similarly complex operations.
Experience reporting directly to a Board of Directors.
Experience leading major capital projects exceeding $10M.
Demonstrated success managing banking and financing relationships.

Preferred

MBA or Master's Degree.
Experience working with Indigenous-owned organizations, governments, or economic development entities.
Experience in a regulated gaming environment.
Experience supporting Board committees and governance functions.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Strategic Leadership & Board Support

Serve as the primary financial advisor to the Board of Directors.
Provide recommendations on strategic initiatives, capital investments, financing structures, business growth opportunities, and organizational performance.
Prepare and present comprehensive financial and operational reports to the Board.
Support the Board in strategic planning and long-term sustainability initiatives.
Participate in governance discussions and provide financial guidance regarding organizational priorities.
Assist the Board in evaluating significant business opportunities, acquisitions, partnerships, and development projects.

________________________________________

Financial Leadership & Stewardship

Lead all aspects of financial management and reporting.
Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with organizational goals.
Oversee:
Budgeting, Forecasting, Financial Reporting
Treasury Management, Cash Flow Management
Internal Controls
Tax Compliance
Audit Functions
Capital Planning
Ensure financial integrity and accountability throughout the organization.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators and financial metrics.

________________________________________

Capital Projects, Renovation & Development Oversight

The CFO will provide executive leadership for capital investment planning and project governance across the resort.

Responsibilities Include

Develop long-term capital investment strategies.
Oversee financial planning and governance for renovation and expansion projects.
Lead financial evaluation and business case development for all major capital expenditures.
Monitor project budgets, timelines, risks, and return on investment.
Ensure appropriate project controls and reporting mechanisms are in place.

________________________________________

Master Site Development Planning

Participate in long-term master planning for Grey Eagle Resort & Casino lands and facilities.
Evaluate future development opportunities through financial modeling and strategic analysis.
Support land use planning, phased development initiatives, and infrastructure investment decisions.
Provide financial leadership related to future resort expansion opportunities.
Collaborate with Nation leadership, developers, consultants, and external advisors regarding future growth initiatives.

________________________________________

Banking, Financing & Capital Structure Management

Lead relationships with financial institutions and lending partners.
Develop financing strategies to support operational and capital requirements.
Negotiate banking agreements, credit facilities, and financing arrangements.
Manage cash reserves and liquidity planning.
Advise the Board regarding capital structure optimization and debt management strategies.

________________________________________

Hotel Asset Management & Resort Performance

Provide strategic oversight regarding the financial performance of hotel and resort assets.
Evaluate asset performance and investment priorities.
Support lifecycle planning for hotel, gaming, entertainment, and food & beverage facilities.
Monitor asset utilization and return on investment.
Develop recommendations regarding reinvestment and asset enhancement opportunities.

________________________________________

Casino Reinvestment Strategy

Develop and maintain a long-term casino reinvestment strategy.
Assess gaming floor performance and capital replacement needs.
Support strategic decisions regarding gaming technology and facility improvements.
Ensure reinvestment planning aligns with market conditions and guest expectations.
Evaluate opportunities to enhance competitiveness and profitability.

________________________________________

iGaming Strategy, Financial Oversight & Business Development

Provide executive financial leadership for the establishment, launch, growth, and ongoing financial performance of GERC's iGaming business unit.
Lead financial modelling, budgeting, forecasting, capital planning, and business-case evaluation related to iGaming operations and strategic initiatives.
Establish and oversee appropriate financial reporting, revenue assurance, reconciliation, treasury, payment processing, settlement, and internal control frameworks for iGaming activities.
Develop and monitor key iGaming performance indicators, including Gross Gaming Revenue (GGR), Net Gaming Revenue (NGR), gaming margins, customer acquisition costs, promotional and bonus costs, player value, deposits and withdrawals, chargebacks, operating costs, and profitability.
Work collaboratively with iGaming leadership, Compliance, Legal, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Marketing, and Operations to ensure appropriate financial governance and risk management.
Ensure financial processes, controls, reporting, and recordkeeping support applicable regulatory requirements and GERC's obligations to Alberta Gaming, Liquor and Cannabis (AGLC) and the Alberta iGaming Corporation (AiGC).
Provide financial oversight of banking arrangements, payment service providers, gaming technology providers, platform vendors, and other significant iGaming commercial relationships.
Evaluate future iGaming products, partnerships, technology investments, and business expansion opportunities from a financial and strategic perspective.

________________________________________

Procurement Governance

Establish financial oversight and governance for procurement activities.
Ensure transparency, accountability, and value-for-money principles.
Develop policies and controls supporting major purchasing initiatives.
Participate in evaluation and approval processes for significant contracts and vendor relationships.
Ensure procurement activities align with Board-approved financial policies.

________________________________________

Indigenous Relations & Partnership Development

Build and maintain respectful relationships with Tsuut'ina Nation leadership and stakeholders.
Support initiatives that align with the Nation's economic development goals.
Identify opportunities for strategic partnerships that advance organizational objectives.
Participate in partnership discussions with Indigenous and non-Indigenous organizations.
Ensure financial strategies reflect the values and long-term interests of ownership.

________________________________________

Stakeholder Management

The CFO Will Maintain Productive Relationships With

Internal Stakeholders

Board of Directors
Executive Leadership Team
Department Leaders
Team Members

External Stakeholders

Tsuut'ina Nation Leadership
Alberta Gaming, Liquor and Cannabis (AGLC)
Alberta iGaming Corporation (AiGC)
Auditors
Financial Institutions
Legal Counsel
Development Partners
Government Agencies
Industry Associations
Consultants and Contractors

________________________________________

Risk Management & Governance

Lead enterprise risk management activities.
Ensure effective internal controls and compliance programs.
Support Board governance and Finance & Audit Committee activities.
Oversee annual external audits.
Ensure compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and accounting standards.
Develop financial risk mitigation strategies.

________________________________________

BOARD FINANCE & AUDIT COMMITTEE SUPPORT

The CFO serves as management's primary liaison to the Finance and Audit Committee and is responsible for:

Preparing committee materials and recommendations.
Presenting financial results and forecasts.
Supporting audit processes.
Monitoring risk management activities.
Reporting on compliance and internal controls.
Supporting governance best practices.

________________________________________

Priority will be given to Tsuut'ina Nation members.

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Director of AI Solutions to lead the design, engineering, and deployment of generative AI and machine learning systems across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for building and scaling production-grade AI systems that directly drive revenue outcomes, including pipeline growth, deal acceleration, customer retention, and operational efficiency.

You will operate at the intersection of AI engineering, enterprise architecture, and go-to-market strategy, partnering closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering leaders to translate AI capabilities into measurable business value.

Responsibilities

Lead End-to-End GenAI and ML System Delivery

Design and deploy generative AI and machine learning solutions embedded in CRM and customer workflows. Build systems including LLM-powered copilots, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, and predictive models. Own the full lifecycle from data sourcing and model development to evaluation, deployment, and monitoring

Drive Hands-On ML Engineering Excellence

Architect and guide implementation of model training and fine-tuning pipelines using frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Hugging Face. Build real-time and batch inference systems, embedding pipelines, and vector database integrations. Establish best practices for CI/CD, experimentation, model evaluation, and observability across AI systems

Scale Agentic AI Systems

Design and deploy agent-based systems capable of multi-step reasoning, tool usage, and workflow orchestration across enterprise platforms. Establish reusable patterns for prompt management, tool integration, policy enforcement, and agent lifecycle management.
Drive Revenue Impact Through AI
Partner with Sales and go-to-market leadership to embed AI into deal strategy and customer engagements. Contribute directly to pipeline growth, deal velocity, and account expansion. Translate AI capabilities into measurable outcomes including conversion improvement, productivity gains, and customer retention.
Lead Cross-Functional Execution
Collaborate across Engineering, Data, Product, Sales, and Customer Success to deliver integrated AI solutions. Translate complex business problems into scalable technical architectures and ensure alignment across systems, data, and workflows.
Build and Lead High-Performing Teams
Lead and grow teams of ML engineers, ML scientists, and AI architects. Establish a high bar for engineering quality, execution, and technical depth. Build scalable development practices and delivery models for enterprise AI.

Qualifications

Experience

12–15+ years of experience in AI/ML, data science, or distributed systems engineering. 8+ years leading ML or AI engineering teams in platform or infrastructure environments. Proven track record delivering production-grade AI systems at enterprise scale. Experience partnering with Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success organizations to drive business outcomes

Technical Expertise

Deep hands-on experience with generative AI including LLMs, prompt engineering, and fine-tuning. Strong experience with retrieval-augmented generation architectures and agentic AI systems. Proficiency with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. Experience with cloud platforms including AWS, GCP, or Azure, and modern data stacks. Strong understanding of distributed systems, CI/CD, experimentation frameworks, and observability

Leadership and Business Acumen

Ability to operate as both a technical leader and business partner. Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills. Experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across highly matrixed organizations. Ability to translate complex technical systems into clear business value
Experience with building AI solutions for Enterprise and driving value through revenue growth like New Logo’s, Recommendations for Crosssell-Upselll
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Salesforce or enterprise CRM ecosystems. Experience building internal AI platforms or developer tooling. Background in SaaS or enterprise software environments. Advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field

As part of HDR’s Building Engineering Services Group, you’ll help design the critical infrastructure that supports the digital age and shapes the spaces where people work, connect, and thrive. From high-performance data centers driving the future of AI to dynamic commercial environments, your work will directly support technological advancement, sustainability, and human experience. We bring together mechanical, electrical, structural, and civil engineering experts to solve complex design challenges with precision, creativity, and collaboration. Whether you're optimizing energy efficiency, integrating resilient systems, or engineering the backbone of next-generation facilities, your contributions will help define the future of the built environment. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead innovation, engineer impact, and build a legacy of excellence.

The Building Engineering Services Business Group (BES BG) Director of Technology will work as part of our Professional Services leadership team, with the primary function of driving a strategic vision and leading a team of experts in the implementation of technology solutions across the multidisciplinary BES consulting practice. In this role, you will collaborate closely with BES leadership, Corporate Technology, operational leadership, technology leaders from throughout the organization, vendors, and other stakeholders to identify, evaluate, and deploy technology initiatives that enhance project execution, efficiency, and innovation.

This position reports to the Professional Services Director and success is measured by the development of effective technology solutions for consulting and project delivery, talent-oriented growth, fostering a technology-focused community of practice, shaping long-term strategic plans, leveraging technology as a market differentiator, and positioning HDR as an industry leader.

Lead a team of technical experts to develop and execute a BES technology vision and roadmap, including strategy and investment planning.
Integrate market-driven, innovative strategies with practical implementation and risk management.
Develop communication strategies to connect BES technology professionals and inform key stakeholders.
Develop and implement communication strategies to engage and inform critical BES stakeholders of technology program, including geographic leadership and market sector leadership.
Standardize technology workflows and delivery practices to improve efficiency and quality
Promote thought leadership through strategy regarding industry awards, publications, speaking engagements, and leadership roles in technology relevant industry organizations.
Lead visioning for technology workforce of the future. Recruit, develop, and retain technology talent.

Work to identify programmatic hardware and software needs, such as high-powered computing and modeling, and work with corporate information technology to facilitate and implement solutions.
Develop strategies and support practice and professional discipline groups to foster technology talent collaboration and skills development.

Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, information science, systems administration, or similar related field.
Minimum of 8 years of experience with at least 5 in the consulting Architecture & Engineering industry
Proven leader with a growth mind-set and the ability to develop and implement technology strategies and drive organizational change.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams to find solutions that advance projects and initiatives
Demonstrated understanding of a broad range of technologies and their applied delivery within the architectural-engineering sector.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a Professional, Architecture, Engineering or closely related field

Provides proactive, integrated, and customized advice and creates and implements wealth planning strategies to help clients achieve their financial and personal goals

Come... Enjoy... Work
in a fast paced, dynamic environment. Located on the Tsuut’ina First Nation, Grey Eagle Resort & Casino is Calgary’s number one entertainment facility. We are looking for talented, energetic and motivated individuals to join our diverse workforce! We offer competitive salaries, benefits and opportunities to grow your career.

Position Overview

The Chief Financial Officer (CFO) is a key executive leader responsible for the financial stewardship, strategic planning, governance support, and long-term sustainability of Grey Eagle Resort & Casino (GERC).

Reporting directly to the Board of Directors, the CFO serves as the principal financial advisor to the Board and Executive Leadership Team, providing leadership across financial operations, capital investment planning, enterprise risk management, business growth initiatives, and stakeholder relations.

The CFO plays a critical role in supporting the Board's vision for sustainable economic growth while protecting and enhancing the assets of Grey Eagle Resort & Casino for future generations of the Tsuut'ina Nation.

The role oversees all financial functions and provides executive leadership for major capital projects, resort renovations, business development initiatives, financing strategies, and governance matters affecting the organization.

As one of the most senior leaders within GERC, the CFO must balance strategic thinking, operational understanding, financial discipline, and relationship-building with a diverse group of stakeholders including the Board of Directors, Tsuut'ina Nation leadership, regulators, financial institutions, development partners, and operational leaders.

CPA designation.
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or related discipline.
Minimum 10 years progressive financial leadership experience.

Experience in hospitality, gaming, resort, entertainment, tourism, real estate development, or similarly complex operations.
Experience reporting directly to a Board of Directors.
Experience leading major capital projects exceeding $10M.
Demonstrated success managing banking and financing relationships.

MBA or Master's Degree.
Experience working with Indigenous-owned organizations, governments, or economic development entities.
Experience in a regulated gaming environment.
Experience supporting Board committees and governance functions.

Participate in governance discussions and provide financial guidance regarding organizational priorities.
Assist the Board in evaluating significant business opportunities, acquisitions, partnerships, and development projects.

Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with organizational goals.

Tax Compliance
Audit Functions
Capital Planning
Ensure financial integrity and accountability throughout the organization.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators and financial metrics.

________________________________________

Capital Projects, Renovation & Development Oversight

The CFO will provide executive leadership for capital investment planning and project governance across the resort.

Develop long-term capital investment strategies.
Oversee financial planning and governance for renovation and expansion projects.
Lead financial evaluation and business case development for all major capital expenditures.
Monitor project budgets, timelines, risks, and return on investment.
Ensure appropriate project controls and reporting mechanisms are in place.

________________________________________

Evaluate future development opportunities through financial modeling and strategic analysis.
Support land use planning, phased development initiatives, and infrastructure investment decisions.

Collaborate with Nation leadership, developers, consultants, and external advisors regarding future growth initiatives.

Develop financing strategies to support operational and capital requirements.
Negotiate banking agreements, credit facilities, and financing arrangements.

Evaluate opportunities to enhance competitiveness and profitability.

Supporting governance best practices.
